name: iGMS Direct Booking
author: igms

sections.description:
iGMS Direct Booking Widget allows your guests to make direct reservations with you right via your website.
Direct Booking Widget is developed by iGMS (www.igms.com). By using the plugin you agree to the iGMS terms of use (https://www.igms.com/terms/). All reservations created and accepted through the Direct Booking Widget are stored, managed, and processed by iGMS in accordance with the privacy policy (https://www.igms.com/privacy-policy/). iGMS is committed to secure your data.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate plugin in plugins section.
  2. Login with your iGMS account.
  3. Install widget in your sidebar or insert widget into page.
  4. In the widget settings, select property to display.
sections.changelog:
2.0

  • WordPress 7.0 and PHP 8.x compatibility.
  • Fixed the editor block (now registers and renders).
  • Minimum WordPress raised to 6.0; minimum PHP raised to 7.4.
  • Security: access-control and input-sanitization hardening across the plugin. Updating is strongly recommended for all sites.
  • Credits: Vulnerability responsibly disclosed by Enrico Marcolini, Claudio Marchesini and Dottor Marc via WPScan.

1.3

  • Updated compatibility with newer WordPress versions.

1.2

  • Fixed bug with placing multiple widgets on one page.

1.1

  • Minor bug fixes.

1.0

  • First release version.
